definitions.full: H4286. machsoph מַחְשׂף noun masculine a laying bare, stripping — only construct הַלָּבָן מַחְשׂף Gen 30:37 (J) a stripping of the white , i.e. so as to shew wood under the bark.

occurrences.englishText: Jacob took to himself rods of fresh poplar, almond, and plane tree, peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
